_doc: ANNOTATED STARTER TEMPLATE. Copy this to definitions/<YourObject>.json and edit. Remove all _doc / _comment lines and any block you don't need before running scaffolder/build.py. The schema is at scaffolder/object_definition.schema.json.
_object_type_doc: PascalCase identity. Becomes the spine class name (+ 'SpineOrchestrator') and registry key. Must NOT collide with an existing object.
_source_key_field_doc: ECC primary key column (e.g., MATNR for Material, KUNNR for Customer, BANFN for PurchaseRequisition). Always uppercase.
_home_table_doc: S/4 system-of-record table — the Reconciler reads target keys back from here to prove persistence.

fk._doc: Source-field -> target object_type. Resolves via PersistentKeyMap at load time.
